name: Nicki Passarella

bio.statement: The district lists Passarella as an associate director for Zone 1 with a term ending January 2027.

source.publisher: Clackamas Soil and Water Conservation District (official site), Associate Directors

verification.note: District Associate Directors page lists 'Nickie Passarella  January 2027  1' (our-people page spells 'Nicki'). Associate directors are non-voting; not the Zone 1 director.

gaps: No public positions or biography found

verification_summary.balance_notes: Clackamas SWCD: four separate unopposed seats. Fantz 3 bio/2 positions, Guttridge 3/3, Zuber 2/0, Passarella 1/0. Only Fantz and Guttridge filed pamphlet statements; Zuber and Passarella have no statement (documented gaps).
